designationHistory.indexText: Crystal River National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1983, is the only refuge created specifically for the protection of the threatened Florida manatee, a subspecies of the West Indian manatee.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
